extracted.intended_audience: Readers and potential contributors to Nature (Victorian scientific magazine); scientific societies and correspondents
extracted.subtask_description: Submission and correspondence rules for letters and communications to the 19th-century magazine Nature, including what will be returned, how anonymous communications are handled, and where subscription/advertising queries should be sent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return of rejected communications
rubrics_metrics.description: We beg leave to state that we decline to return rejected communications, and to this rule we can make no exception.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit, absolute policy: the journal will not return any rejected submissions and makes no exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to address subscription/advertisement communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications respecting Subscriptions or Advertisements must be addressed to the Publishers, NOT to the Editor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative queries (subscriptions, adverts) are handled by the publishers, not the editorial office. Address such matters to the publishers rather than the editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor disclaimer for correspondents' opinions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editor does not hold himself responsible for opinions expressed by his correspondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published letters and communications represent the views of their authors; the editor disclaims responsibility for those opinions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of anonymous communications
rubrics_metrics.description: No notice is taken of anonymous communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anonymous letters or submissions will not be considered or noticed by the journal.
